wc:minerva-virtual-list.summary: Windowed list rendering only the visible rows.
wc:minerva-virtual-list.description: A windowed (virtualized) list: only the rows in view (plus `overscan` rows above and below) are in the DOM (`<VirtualList>` of React). Rows have a fixed height (`item-height`, or measured from the first item). - Data: set the `items` property (`{ id, metadata? }[]`) and a `renderItem(item, index)` function property returning text, a Node or a Lit template. Rows are rendered in the shadow root: style their content with inline styles / your own elements, or through `::part(item)`. - The scroll container is a focusable `region` (keyboard scrolling) named by `aria-label`; rows are `listitem`s exposing their real position (`aria-setsize` / `aria-posinset`). The row holding focus stays rendered when scrolled out of the window (focus is never dropped). - `clickable` (React: passing `onItemClick`) makes rows focusable and activatable with Enter / Space: `minerva-item-click`. - Scrolling near the bottom fires `minerva-load-more` (once until `items` or `loading` change).

properties.description: Padding of each row in pixels

properties.description: Number of rows rendered above and below the visible area

properties.name: maxHeight
properties.description: Maximum height of the scroll container in pixels

properties.name: loadMoreThreshold
properties.description: Distance from the bottom (px) at which `minerva-load-more` fires

properties.name: highPerformance
properties.description: Batches scroll updates with requestAnimationFrame and requestIdleCallback

properties.name: loading
properties.description: Shows a loading indicator at the bottom of the list (aria-busy)

properties.name: clickable
properties.description: Rows are clickable: focusable, pointer cursor, `minerva-item-click`

properties.name: renderItem
properties.description: Renders the content of one row (text, Node or Lit template)

properties.name: scrollContainer
properties.description: The scroll container (e.g. to scroll programmatically)

translationResources.title: VirtualList 虚拟列表

basic.title: 基础用法
basic.description: 10,000 行数据，固定 itemHeight；DOM 中只存在可见行（以及 overscan 预渲染的行）。

auto-height.title: 自动测量行高
auto-height.description: 不传 itemHeight 时根据第一个渲染项测量行高；每行四周会加上 itemPadding。

infinite-scroll.title: 无限滚动
infinite-scroll.description: 滚动到接近底部时调用 onLoadMore；加载期间显示加载指示器。

high-performance.title: 高性能模式
high-performance.description: highPerformance 使用 requestAnimationFrame 和 requestIdleCallback 合并滚动更新，此示例包含 100,000 行。

clickable-rows.title: 可点击行与原生属性
clickable-rows.description: onItemClick 让行可点击（指针光标、可聚焦、可用 Enter / Space 激活）；未设置时行保持默认光标。id、data-*、aria-* 等原生属性会传递到根元素。

VirtualListProps.itemHeight: 固定行高（像素）；不传时根据第一个列表项测量
VirtualListProps.overscan: 在可视区域上方和下方额外渲染的行数
VirtualListProps.maxHeight: 滚动容器的最大高度（像素）
VirtualListProps.onLoadMore: 滚动到接近底部时调用；返回一个在新数据加载完成后 resolve 的 Promise（在其完成前不会再次调用）
VirtualListProps.loadMoreThreshold: 距底部多少像素时触发 onLoadMore
VirtualListProps.highPerformance: 使用 requestAnimationFrame 和 requestIdleCallback 合并滚动更新
VirtualListProps.loading: 在列表底部显示加载指示器
VirtualListProps.ref: 根（滚动容器）<div> 元素的 ref
VirtualListProps.onItemClick: 点击行，或行本身聚焦时按 Enter / Space 时调用。使行可点击：可聚焦并显示指针光标

VirtualListItem.metadata: 供 renderItem 使用的任意数据
